snippet.title: 60 Minutes, Not 90! ⏰ Riddle #18 Answer + Riddle #19: 17 Sheep 🐑 #shorts
snippet.description:
Last riddle: three tablets, one every half hour, starting right now. How many minutes?
The first tablet is taken right now, at 0 minutes. The second at 30, the third at 60. Three tablets, only two gaps. The answer is 60 minutes. ✅

Riddle #19 🐑
Person 1 has 17 sheep on a farm.
One stormy night, all but 9 of them run away.
Person 2 says: 8 are left. Person 3 says: no way!

So how many sheep does Person 1 have now?
Comment 1, 2 or 3:
1) 8 sheep
2) 9 sheep
3) 17 sheep
The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise. ☀️
